fields.name: Name
fields.passwordHint: The password of your panel account.
fields.emailHint: You will sign in with this address.
fields.nameHint: How the panel will call you.
fields.loginEmailHint: The address you sign in with.

setup.title: Set up this server
setup.description: Create the account you'll use to run this server.
setup.codeHint: It's in the server log, on the /setup?token=… line printed when the panel started, and in the setup-token file in the panel's data directory.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Welcome back. Enter your details to reach this server.
login.remember: Keep me signed in on this browser

twoFactor.title: Enter your code
twoFactor.description: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for this server.
twoFactor.recoveryDescription: Enter one of the codes you saved when you turned on two-factor sign-in. Each one works only once.
twoFactor.useAuthenticator: Use a code from your app instead
twoFactor.codeHint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryCodeHint: One of the codes you saved when you turned this on.

errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.recoveryCode: Enter a recovery code, like abcd-efgh-jkmn-pqrs.

invitation.title: Join this server
invitation.asAdmin: {{inviter}} invited you to administer this server. Choose your name and a password to create your account.
invitation.asMember: {{inviter}} invited you to this server. Choose your name and a password to create your account.
invitation.unreachable: Your invitation could not be checked just now.
invitation.emailHint: You'll sign in with this address.
invitation.invalidDescription: It was used, replaced or taken back, or it expired. Ask an administrator of this server for a new one.

twoFactorRequired.title: Turn on two-factor sign-in
twoFactorRequired.description: This server requires it of every account. You can use the panel as soon as it is on.

cliLogin.title: Sign in the command line
cliLogin.description: The command line on “{{client}}” asks to act as you on this panel for 24 hours, account administration included.
cliLogin.codeLabel: Check that your terminal shows this code
cliLogin.otherAddress: This request came from another address ({{address}}) than this browser's. If you did not run opsifier login --web yourself, refuse it.
cliLogin.unknownAddress: The panel could not tell where this request came from. If you did not run opsifier login --web yourself, refuse it.
cliLogin.confirmWithCode: Enter the code from your authenticator app to allow it.
cliLogin.confirmWithPassword: Enter your password to allow it.
cliLogin.approvedTitle: The command line is signed in
cliLogin.approvedDescription: You can close this page and go back to your terminal.
cliLogin.deniedDescription: The command line has been told. Nothing was signed in.
cliLogin.goneTitle: This request is no longer waiting
cliLogin.goneDescription: It has expired, was already answered, or does not exist. Run opsifier login --web again.
cliLogin.missingDescription: Open the link exactly as the command line printed it.
